title: Perf: Delta-Only WebSocket Broadcast
description: The live dashboard feed now sends only the parts of the snapshot that actually changed since the previous 2-second tick instead of the entire snapshot every time, cutting payload size and serialization work on sections like SSL certificates and Git projects that rarely change.
highlights: Periodic WebSocket updates now carry only changed top-level snapshot sections; a newly connected browser still always gets the full snapshot first.
No visible behavior change — this is a transport-level optimization, the dashboard still updates every 2 seconds.

title: Perf: Docker Stats Streaming, Cheaper Thermal Read
description: Container CPU/memory monitoring now reads from one persistent stats stream per running container instead of polling every container's stats over a fresh Docker API call each 2-second tick, and CPU package temperature reads /sys/class/thermal directly instead of probing sensors on every poll.
highlights: Docker container monitoring: one open stats stream per running container (capped at 30) replaces a per-container stats() round-trip every tick; streams close automatically when a container stops or monitoring mode turns off.
CPU temperature: reads a cached /sys/class/thermal zone directly; falls back to the heavier sensor-probing library only on platforms without a usable zone, throttled to once per 30 seconds.

title: Fix: Host CPU% and Disk Performance Accuracy
description: Host CPU usage now reflects real utilization from /proc/stat instead of load average, disk performance resolves each mount to its actual block device instead of guessing from the mount path's own name, and a snapshot no longer hides that the primary host fell back to demo data just because a secondary host stayed connected.
highlights: Host CPU%: computed from a /proc/stat idle/total delta between polls, matching how load-average-independent monitoring tools measure utilization; falls back to the old load-average estimate only on platforms without /proc/stat.

Disk performance: mounts are matched to /proc/diskstats by their real major:minor device identity instead of a substring guess on the mount path ('media'/'cloud'/'music'); a mount that can't be resolved (e.g. LVM/device-mapper) now shows 'not available' instead of fabricated numbers.

Snapshot honesty: each Docker host's 'connected' status now reflects that tick's actual fetch result, and isDemoMode is keyed off the primary host specifically instead of any configured host being live.

title: Git Projects: Pull & Rebuild Over SSH
description: Tracked projects can now be pulled and rebuilt on a separate Docker host or LXC, not just the one Homelab Cockpit itself runs on — pick an SSH target in the edit dialog and the pull and rebuild run there instead.
highlights: Track a Git Project: new 'Runs on' selector lists your configured SSH targets (the same ones Terminal and Processes use) alongside the default 'this daemon' option.
With an SSH target picked, Local path becomes an absolute path on that remote host instead of a folder name under GIT_PROJECTS_ROOT.
Pull & rebuild's live log, migration-risk check, and auto-deploy all work the same way for a remote target as they do locally — same fixed git/docker sequence, just run over SSH.
Docs: CLAUDE.md and the user manual updated; the standing single-host warning in the tracking form now explains the SSH target option instead.

title: Git Projects: Single-Host Limitation Warning
description: The Track a Git Project form now states plainly that pull & rebuild only works for containers running on the same Docker daemon as Homelab Cockpit itself — picking a different configured host in the tab strip only filters the container list, it doesn't extend where the rebuild can run.
highlights: Track a Git Project: added a standing warning explaining that pull & rebuild always targets this daemon's own docker.sock, not a remote configured host.
Docs: CLAUDE.md and the user manual now document this scope explicitly alongside the existing primary-host-only services list.
.env.example: refreshed the DOCKER_HOSTS example entry to match the current host naming (yado-hosts).

title: Fix: Container Links Now Resolve to Their Own Docker Host
description: Container LAN/Tailscale links previously pointed at the primary Docker host's IP regardless of which configured host the container actually ran on. Fixed so each host resolves its own LAN and Tailscale address.
highlights: Container Fleet: containers on additional Docker hosts (e.g. whitearchive-hosts) now get LAN/Tailscale links pointing at that host's own IP, not the primary host's — fixes clicking a container's port badge opening the wrong service when both hosts happened to use the same port.
Docker hosts without a configured Tailscale IP (not yet joined the tailnet) no longer inherit the primary host's Tailscale address.
New env config: DOCKER_HOST_LAN_IP / DOCKER_HOST_TAILSCALE_IP for the primary host, and an extended DOCKER_HOSTS format (name=url|lanIp|tailscaleIp) for additional hosts.

title: Shortcut Group Management, Full Logs Inspector & English Localization
description: Streamlined shortcut management with group rename & deletion modal, removed manual drag/drop order and duplicate repo link, added full log inspector for system audit trails and container logs, and unified the entire dashboard interface into English.
highlights: Shortcut Groups Management: Easily rename custom groups or delete groups with options to keep or remove associated shortcuts.
Streamlined Shortcuts: Removed drag-and-drop manual ordering and duplicate repository link in favor of automatic group sorting and the dedicated Homelab Updater.
Full System & Container Logs: Added detailed inspector modal for system audit logs with copy-to-clipboard raw payloads, plus expanded container log tailing options (up to 1,000 lines or full output).
Unified English Localization: All user interface labels, alerts, update banner states, and tooltips are now cleanly synchronized in English.

title: Full Container Management, System Logs Page & UI Overhaul
description: Perombakan UI (sidebar sticky, header dirapikan, animasi interaksi) plus fitur baru: manajemen penuh container (start/stop/restart, default card view, filter pinned, sort), halaman Logs untuk audit trail lengkap, timestamp pull & redeploy di Git Projects, grouping shortcut, dan detail tambahan di AI Agents Monitor.
highlights: Sidebar sekarang benar-benar sticky mengikuti viewport saat scroll, tidak lagi ikut ter-scroll bersama konten.
Header dirapikan: tombol Settings/Fullscreen/Refresh/Sign out digabung ke satu menu 'More' agar tidak berantakan.
Container Fleet: default tampilan Card, filter Pinned/All, dan kontrol penuh start/stop/restart per container.
Halaman Logs baru: audit trail lengkap (auth, pin, container, git, backup, config, error) dengan filter kategori/level dan pencarian.
Git Projects menampilkan jam & tanggal pull & redeploy terakhir.
Shortcuts (Bookmarks) kini bisa dikelompokkan berdasarkan grup buatan sendiri.
AI Agents Monitor menampilkan turns hari ini, waktu aktif terakhir, dan disclaimer transparansi bahwa angka 5-jam/mingguan adalah estimasi lokal, bukan limit resmi dari akun.

title: Standalone Out-of-Process Redeployer & Seamless Service Reconnect
description: Menghadirkan skrip eksekusi mandiri di host (scripts/homelab-redeploy.sh & /root/homelab-redeploy.sh) dan watcher daemon untuk proses redeploy yang kebal dari terminasi container, serta auto-reconnect cerdas saat service sempat down.
highlights: Standalone Host Redeployer (scripts/homelab-redeploy.sh): Skrip mandiri di host (/root/homelab-redeploy.sh) yang melakukan auto-stash, fetch, reset, auto-heal network Docker 'homelab-net', dan docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate tanpa terputus ketika container cockpit direstart.

Watcher / Daemon Mode (--watch): Daemon pemantau trigger file yang siap dijalankan di host atau sebagai systemd service (scripts/homelab-redeploy.service) untuk menangkap perintah redeploy dari web dashboard secara real-time.

Seamless Downtime & Auto-Reconnect: Ketika container sedang direcreate dan koneksi terputus sesaat ('service sempet down'), UI dashboard tidak menampilkan fatal error melainkan status transisi 'Service Restarting', memantau /api/health secara berkala, dan otomatis reload saat container baru aktif ('trus naik lagi').

title: Removed Beta UI & Instant Primary Node Customization
description: Menghapus rute dan layout Beta UI sepenuhnya untuk menyederhanakan antarmuka kembali ke Classic Glassmorphism, serta memperbaiki bug persistensi dan siaran nama custom Primary Node.
highlights: Cleaned up Beta UI: Menghapus layout, header, sidebar, dan rute /beta sepenuhnya sehingga dashboard kembali fokus pada antarmuka utama yang stabil.
Instant Primary Node Name: Memperbaiki siaran WebSocket dan penulisan setting sehingga nama custom Primary Node langsung teraplikasikan seketika di seluruh tampilan.
Streamlined User Settings: Memfokuskan modal pengaturan pada kustomisasi nama node, tema warna (Dark/Light), dan keamanan akun owner.

title: User Settings Hub, Node Renaming & Git Project Failure Recovery
description: Menghadirkan panel User Settings terpadu untuk kustomisasi tema dan UI Style (Classic Glassmorphism vs Neo-Brutalism), kustomisasi nama Primary Node, ganti password login owner, serta tombol pemulihan Repull & Redeploy jika status Git project failed.
highlights: User Settings Hub: Modal pengaturan komprehensif untuk memilih UI Style (Classic Glassmorphism vs Neo-Brutalism), Color Theme (Dark/Light), dan preferensi tampilan.
Dynamic Primary Node Name: Fleksibilitas mengganti label Primary Node (PVE / host) langsung dari dashboard dan disimpan di server dengan siaran real-time via WebSocket.
Password Management: Fitur ubah password akun owner / one-time login dengan verifikasi aman scrypt dan konfirmasi password baru.

Git Project Failure Recovery: Menyediakan tombol Repull & Redeploy (Force Sync) dan Retry Check saat terjadi kegagalan check upstream atau status failed, serta auto-clean file .git/index.lock yang tertinggal.

title: Full Feature Parity & Shortcuts System for Beta Brutalist UI
description: Menyempurnakan Beta Brutalist UI dengan menghadirkan seluruh fitur yang sebelumnya hanya ada di Legacy UI: Command Palette internal routing, bookmark shortcuts dengan brutalist card styling, panel notifikasi, collapsible sidebar, sensor thermal CPU, dan quick action deck.
highlights: Integrated Shortcuts & Bookmarks: Menghadirkan kembali Personal Web Shortcuts di HomePageBeta dengan styling brutalist kontras tinggi, empty state action, dan visual card hover effect.
Command Palette Preservation: Navigasi via Ctrl+K di dalam Beta UI kini secara otomatis mempertahankan rute /beta/* sehingga pengguna tidak terlempar kembali ke Legacy UI.
Collapsible Beta Sidebar: Menambahkan tombol toggle expand/collapse pada BetaSidebar dengan persistensi localStorage untuk area kerja yang lebih luas.
Complete Vitals & Telemetry Parity: Menambahkan CPU load %, RAM used/total, sensor suhu Package Temp / Thermal, dan Quick Action launchpad ke dalam Beta Overview.

title: Force Pull & Auto-Stash Resilient Git Project Redeploy
description: Menghilangkan kegagalan pull & redeploy akibat konflik perubahan lokal pada file repository (misal docker-compose.yml), dengan menerapkan force pull bersih via git fetch & reset --hard serta auto-stash pengaman data.
highlights: Force Pull Pipeline: Mengganti git pull standar dengan git fetch + git reset --hard origin/<branch> untuk memastikan kontainer selalu ter-redeploy tanpa error Aborting.

Auto-Stash Data Protection: Perubahan lokal pada file tracked tersimpan otomatis ke git stash sebelum reset, sementara file untracked (.env, direktori database, volume data) tetap aman dan tidak tersentuh.

title: Fix Window Auto-Scroll Lock during App Update
description: Memperbaiki bug di mana browser window secara paksa ditarik ke bawah saat proses "Sedang memperbarui dashboard...", sehingga pengguna kini bebas scroll ke atas dan membaca log tanpa gangguan.
highlights: Container-Scoped Auto-Scroll: Mengganti pemanggilan scrollIntoView() global dengan scrollTo({ top: scrollHeight }) langsung pada kontainer terminal AppUpdateBanner.
Scroll Freedom: Mencegah pembajakan scroll window browser saat log update diperbarui tiap detik, memungkinkan pengguna melihat bagian atas modal maupun dashboard dengan leluasa.

title: Beta UI Brutalist Perfection & Dedicated Storage SMART Watchdog
description: Penyempurnaan visual Brutalist menyeluruh pada Beta UI, optimasi responsivitas mobile phone, serta pemisahan Storage & DAS Watchdog menjadi section mandiri lengkap dengan telemetri SMART dan I/O real-time.
highlights: Dedicated Storage & DAS Watchdog: Memisahkan panel penyimpanan dari kolom sempit menjadi section penuh mandiri di InfraPage dengan detail LVM-thin allocations dan container workloads.
Real-Time SMART & I/O Telemetry: Menampilkan status SMART (PASSED/WARNING), throughput baca/tulis live (MB/s), active time disk %, serta latensi respons secara langsung.
Enhanced Canary Watchdog: Visualisasi status deteksi file .mounted live dengan pulse indicator untuk mencegah risiko overflow root filesystem saat enclosure eksternal terputus.
Overview Real-time Storage Vital: Menambahkan blok ringkasan Storage & DAS Watchdog ke dalam grid Core Vitals HomePage Beta.
Universal Brutalist Styling: Reset sudut rounded-none, penonaktifan backdrop blur, kustomisasi brutalist scrollbars, dan animasi snappy 0.08s di seluruh antarmuka Beta.
Mobile UX Refinement: Navigasi horizontal bar yang ergonomis dan penataan header actions rapi tanpa horizontal overflow pada layar HP.

title: Beta UI Overview Feature Parity & Mobile Support
description: Menyempurnakan dashboard utama Beta UI agar memiliki fitur yang setara dengan versi Legacy dan menyesuaikan dukungan tampilan di layar HP.
highlights: Feature Parity: Memasang App Update Banner dan panel Bookmarks Shortcuts ke dalam halaman HomePage Beta (Brutalist UI)
Mobile CSS Grid: Memperbaiki styling class column untuk layout HP (misalnya menggunakan grid-cols-1 vs grid-cols-2) sehingga grid Brutalist tetap rapi dan tidak tumpang tindih pada layar sempit

title: Smart Auto-Scroll Logs & Force Update Button
description: Perbaikan UX pada terminal live update dan penambahan tombol paksa untuk App Updater, menyelesaikan keluhan scroll window yang terkunci otomatis.
highlights: Smart Auto-Scroll: Jendela log pada saat proses pull & redeploy Git Project maupun App Updater tidak lagi me-lock layar secara paksa ke baris terbaru jika pengguna sengaja melakukan scroll ke atas.

Force App Update: Menambahkan tombol 'Pull & Redeploy' di status bar Overview (saat aplikasi dicek sudah berstatus Up to date) sehingga pengguna bisa memaksa eksekusi ulang siklus pembaruan Dashboard secara mandiri.

title: Global Brutalist Beta UI Architecture & Layout Engine
description: Perombakan arsitektur frontend dengan menambahkan layout mandiri bergaya Brutalist (Beta UI). Seluruh komponen dan rute dalam web kini memiliki dua mode tampilan secara global yang dapat dialihkan instan melalui tombol Header.
highlights: Brutalist UI Mode: Desain antarmuka konstruktivis murni dengan struktur border tebal, tanpa blur, dan stark grid base
Global Layout Engine: Pemisahan Legacy UI dan Beta UI dengan CSS environment blocker tanpa menduplikasi komponen halaman
Header Seamless Toggle: Tombol sentral untuk beralih antara Classic UI dan Beta UI dengan navigasi rute seketika menuju `/beta/`
Pembaruan Dokumentasi: Pembersihan screenshot lawas di README menyisakan overview interface dashboard utama

title: Real-Time Update Engine, Fleet Card Sorting & T3 Volume Wire
description: Pembaruan mesin self-updater dengan pemantauan commit real-time di latar belakang, auto-recovery rebase yang tangguh jika terjadi divergensi git lokal, fitur sorting fleksibel di mode kartu armada (Fleet Card View), dan integrasi volume persistensi T3 Code.
highlights: Real-Time Updater: Deteksi update commit GitHub secara otomatis di latar belakang tiap 30-60 detik tanpa perlu reload halaman
Auto-Fetch & Resilient Rebase: Eksekusi git fetch otomatis saat cek update dan pemulihan cerdas jika terjadi divergensi cabang lokal
Fleet Cards Sort Controls: Kemampuan mengurutkan kontainer berdasarkan Nama, CPU, RAM, atau Network dengan toggle ASC/DESC di mode kartu
Integrasi Volume T3 Code: Mounting volume baca-saja data T3 Code pada docker-compose untuk telemetri AI Agent tanpa hambatan

title: AI Agents Monitor, Glassmorphism UI & Fleet Cards View
description: Menghadirkan fitur pemantauan penggunaan AI Agent multi-tenant (Claude Pro & Gemini) langsung dari telemetri T3 Code, tampilan antarmuka Glassmorphism modern dengan transisi halus, mode tampilan kartu (Cards vs Table) pada armada kontainer, dan perbaikan kestabilan updater.
highlights: AI Agents Monitor: Pantau penggunaan 4 AI agent (Claude Pro, Gemini Default, Auth, Marmut) dengan limit sliding 5 jam dan hitung mundur cooldown detik-demi-detik
Riwayat Mingguan & Stream Interaksi: Grafik batang 7 hari per agent dan log eksekusi model secara real-time
Desain Visual Glassmorphism: Desain panel transparan modern dengan backdrop blur, border glow, dan animasi fade-in-up
Fleet Cards vs Table View: Tombol toggle tata letak kartu grid atau tabel responsif pada Container Fleet
Stabilitas Self-Updater: Otomasi monorepo npm workspaces dan perbaikan eksekusi build di container produksi

title: Fitur Update Otomatis, Drag & Drop Shortcuts & Header Cleanup
description: Dashboard kini dapat diupdate langsung dari Overview dengan sekali klik tanpa perlu manual pull & redeploy. Menambahkan sistem pengumuman update otomatis dari commit/announcements, reorder shortcuts dengan drag & drop, card shortcut dapat diklik seluruhnya, dan pembersihan info hardware di header.
highlights: Fitur One-Click Update homelab-dashboard dari Overview tanpa perlu manual pull & redeploy
Announcement sistem update otomatis dengan ringkasan pembaruan
Shortcut langsung ke repository GitHub
Penyusunan urutan shortcuts dengan fitur Drag and Drop lalu klik Save
Seluruh kotak shortcut dapat diklik untuk membuka tautan di tab baru
Pembersihan strip info hardware PVE, Docker host, Tailnet, Containers, dan CPU di Header
